messages:
elaine: heads-up: found a nasty parity/shape drift for the batch embeddings route between REST and the Go SDK. REST accepts metadata as JSON objects and preserves types, SDK serializes all metadata values to strings which trips model routing (we have a rule that routes by numeric "priority" in metadata). Caused unexpected model fallback and ~2x cost for a customer.
omar: ugh. do you have a minimal repro?
elaine: yup. curl that behaves correctly (routes to cheaper embedder):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings/batch \
  -d '{"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"foo","metadata":{"priority":10}},{"id":"a2","text":"bar","metadata":{"priority":5}}]}'
```
-> server picks model 'embed-small' for priority <=10.

elaine: Go SDK (v0.3.5) call in sampleapp:
```go
items := []EmbeddingItem{
  {ID: "a1", Text: "foo", Metadata: map[string]interface{}{"priority": 10}},
  {ID: "a2", Text: "bar", Metadata: map[string]interface{}{"priority": 5}},
}
client.Embeddings.Batch(items)
// Observed request body (raw): {"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"foo","metadata":{"priority":"10"}}, ... ]}
// Server then routes to 'embed-large' because it sees priority as string and falls back to costlier policy.
```

jin: where is the conversion happening? generator or serializer?
okatie: quick grep: codegen marks metadata as map[string]string in the generated models for Go (oops) even though REST schema allows map<string,any>. So ints get stringified at compile time.
omar: that's consistent with a few other Go SDK bugs. Short-term mitigation: patch the Go SDK to use map[string]interface{} in the model, and add a serializer that preserves native numeric types. Longer-term: fix generator schema mappings and add a cross-language parity test.

ci-bot: test failure created: T-9257 embedding_batch_parity observed on staging: mismatch of metadata types leads to model routing differences. Linked logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/embeddings-e2e/812.

elaine: customer impact: two customers hit this in last 48h. One reported doubled billing for embedding usage. We should hotfix Go SDK and publish v0.3.6. Also update sampleapp Go snippets to explicitly show metadata typed values for now.

jin: +1. Also add a lint in generator to flag when body map types are generated as map[string]string. We've seen this pattern cause subtle regressions.
okatie: I'll open RED-3533 to track (1) generator mapping fix, (2) Go SDK hotfix, (3) parity e2e job to compare SDK payload vs canonical REST fixtures for embeddings endpoints, (4) sampleapp updates and changelog entry.
omar: for hotfix PR please include unit test asserting raw JSON (not just roundtrip marshaling) and an e2e check against staging routing heuristics.

devex-bot: scheduled a sprint task card: DEVEX-110 (embedding-metadata-parity) and assigned to @katie and @jin.

elaine: thanks. follow-ups: watch for other SDKs with aggressive stringification (noticed similar mention in Java recently), add a short blurb in onboarding docs about metadata typing, and run a quick scan across SDKs for map<,any> vs map<,string> mismatches. tagging @devex and @eng-runtime for visibility.
